CustomField.description: If this is checked/TRUE, then when an Object Tag record is created from the specified "Object Prefix" LWC then it will use the value in the "Related Field Name" to populate into Lead__c, Contact__c or Opportunity__c. If this is unchecked/FALSE, then when the Object Tag record is created it from the specified "Object Prefix" LWC then it will use the current record to populate into Lead__c, Contact__c or Opportunity__c. If Use Related Object = TRUE, then it’s going to use the Related Field Name as it’s own ID. So for example, when you create a tag on case, it’s sending the Object Tag the contact ID because the related field name is ContactId and Use Related Object = TRUE. The Object Tag takes that ID, looks at the first 3 characters of the ID, determines it’s a Contact, and places it in the Contact__c field.
